description: DTDL v2 schema for the CPU and Network MetricTypes documented in docs/Metrics/01_CPU_NETWORK_FIELDS.md. Each Telemetry corresponds to one (MetricType, MetricName) pair emitted by SystemMetricsParser. The schemas[] array publishes reusable Enums for MetricType / MetricName / SensorGroup / SensorInfo.Schema; every Telemetry carries a comment field with the validation rule downstream consumers should apply.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface. Validation: Parameters.MetricType MUST equal one of these literals.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when Parameters.MetricType == 'cpu'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when Parameters.MetricType == 'network'.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. CPU and Network sensors conventionally use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema. Validation: must match the Telemetry's native DTDL schema (see Telemetry.schema below).

contents.name: CpuUsage
contents.description: Overall CPU busy % across all cores (0.00-100.00). MetricType=cpu, MetricName=usage.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= 100 (rounded to 2 dp); reject NaN / +-Inf as sensor faults; sustained v > 95 for >= 5 min indicates saturation. Unit: percent.

contents.name: CpuLoad1
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless; v > 2 * nproc for >= 5 min indicates sustained overload. Returns 0.0 on non-Linux platforms.

contents.name: CpuLoad5
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless. Same overload threshold as CpuLoad1.

contents.name: CpuLoad15
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless. Same overload threshold as CpuLoad1.

contents.name: CpuContextSwitches
contents.description: Cumulative scheduler context-switch count since boot (/proc/stat ctxt). MetricType=cpu, MetricName=context_switches.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0 between samples; resets only on reboot (detect via system.boot_time). Always graph as rate, not absolute value.

contents.name: NetworkBytesSent
contents.description: Cumulative L2 bytes transmitted on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=bytes_sent.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [bps].

contents.name: NetworkBytesReceived
contents.description: Cumulative L2 bytes received on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=bytes_received.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [bps].

contents.name: NetworkPacketsSent
contents.description: Cumulative TX frame count on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=packets_sent.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [pps].

contents.name: NetworkPacketsReceived
contents.description: Cumulative RX frame count on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=packets_received.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [pps].

contents.name: NetworkErrors
contents.description: Cumulative total network errors (errors_in + errors_out) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0. Any sustained non-zero rate on Ethernet is abnormal -- investigate cable / NIC / driver.

contents.name: NetworkErrorsIn
contents.description: Cumulative receive errors (CRC / framing / FIFO drops) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors_in.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0. Non-zero rate typically signals layer-1 problems (cabling, transceiver, FIFO overflow under load).

contents.name: NetworkErrorsOut
contents.description: Cumulative transmit errors (carrier loss / device failure) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors_out.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0. Non-zero rate typically signals carrier loss or device-side TX failure.
